title: The Key Fox and the Lantern Festival Treasure
moral: True treasure is meant to help everyone, not just one person.

scenes.text: Lena and her friends discover that the town’s lantern festival may be canceled due to lack of money.
scenes.image_prompt: four girls in town square looking worried near empty banner pole

scenes.text: They notice a fox-with-a-key symbol on the fountain and find clues in the library pointing to hidden treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: girls studying old map in library with fox symbol highlighted

scenes.text: They explore orchard hill, an old playhouse, and a bridge, collecting tokens and solving riddles.
scenes.image_prompt: girls exploring secret tunnel, old theater, and stone bridge with clues

scenes.text: At the clock tower, they open a hidden chamber using teamwork and discover a community treasure fund.
scenes.image_prompt: hidden chamber with chest opening and glowing tokens inside clock tower

scenes.text: They return the treasure to the town and successfully restore the lantern festival for everyone.
scenes.image_prompt: lantern festival at night with glowing lights and happy crowd

story: Lena and her friends work together to find a hidden treasure meant for the town. By solving clues and staying united, they save the lantern festival and learn that true treasure belongs to the whole community.
